title: LIVE WTA Finals Indian Wells Day One | Linda Noskova and Marta Kostyuk battle for opening win

 WTA by Cristhián Avila Sunday, 08 November 2026 at 21:52 Follow us on Google! 0 The 2026 WTA Finals get underway at Indian Wells with Group 1 action, as Wimbledon champion Linda Noskova takes on an unexpected opponent in Marta Kostyuk . The Ukrainian secured a last-minute place in the draw as an alternate after Elena Rybakina withdrew just 24 hours before her scheduled debut. ARTICLE_IN_2

 mandoist 08-11-2026 Vukov is doing this to Lena... AGAIN!!!!!
WTA's autonomous collective should be dismantled for allowing Vukov to re-emerge from his hand-slapping suspension. Just ask WTA employees how that's been going lately as they witness his continued verbal abuses.
Women's Pro Tennis should start over. 
 mandoist 08-11-2026 Can't help but suspect Vukov is back to his old self again.
Thank you, WTA. Perhaps you can give them a "Battling Couple of the Year Award 2026" ?? 
 Bel 08-11-2026 Wtf? Why is there no reason? And what about the men's? 
 mandoist 06-11-2026 One step by another step -- WTA continues to 'lose the plot'.
Too many hi-tech microphones being installed at most venues!!!
Remove them (especially those along the hallways, sidewalks, and pathways throughout the venues.
Not to mention (most of all) remove the mic's from the Players/Coaches Box. 
 mandoist 06-11-2026 Enough of her bullshit.
Go marry someone. 
 Rapunzel 05-11-2026 Don't you just love this young lady!? We fans often expect athletes to be supermen and superwomen, often forgetting that they WILL GET TIRED! I love Alex's perspective. Tiredness for an athlete should never be viewed as a negative, especially if you are healthy, taking care of your body and mental health and putting in the work. What a mature perspective. Good for you, Alex! 
 Rapunzel 05-11-2026 Jess is absolutely correct! But the disrespect is a trait I have noticed in most of the Russian players. Mirra is good but very immature and lacks humility. Conceivable needs to get a handle on that! 
 mandoist 05-11-2026 Having spent weeks and weeks through the years on tour, I can say with confidence that Conchita was (is) one of the very few who realize the surprising level of maturity (and sometimes lack of) which Mirra seems to have developed in such a demanding adult world of Pro-Tennis. While at the same time reminding herself (Conchita, that is) that Mirra is still young and developing mentally and physically.
The general public may forget at times, or not at all realize, these modern era young athletes do not have a 'normal' Youth. It's a major sacrifice, among countless sacrifices, these athletes must make. 
People who blow-off that fact are ignorant and unfair when they blurt out, "They choose fame so they have to put up with the intrusions on their lives".
No, they do not. 
 mandoist 05-11-2026 Okay... someone with a camera was EAVESDROPPING on a private conversation. Shouldn't that be the point of discussion here?
Regardless of the sensationalist crap by media, Pegula (and anyone) has a right to an opinion. There used to be an expectation that private conversations were respected, regardless of 'stardom' and whatever other defensive excuses media tries to shove in our faces. 
Boo-hoo if feelings are hurt. 
BTW: Having been employed at various tourney venues, etc., I can't tell you how nasty and offensive players can be when discussing their opponents and colleagues... in "private". Well, I could, but won't.
I also challenge anyone to deny what Jessica said is false. 
 Trwd77 02-11-2026 Vacherot is Mongasque, rather than Swiss. The tournament was Swiss :D
